independent_review.candidate_a_blocker: When Agent recovery failed, a stale registry release could reset a valid Matrix window for the unresolved actual lease release.
independent_review.candidate_b_resolution: Named MatrixRestartRecovery states distinguish successful process recovery from unresolved process identity. Always validate and hydrate the companion window. If the active release mismatches or is absent under unresolved recovery, pause Matrix retries in memory and return before reset or persistence. Matching release paths retain normalization; only resolved release changes can reset the Matrix window.
